spanish: E hicieron dos anillos de oro, y los pusieron sobre los dos extremos del pectoral, sobre su labio que al lado del efod hacia adentro.
grammarChanges: Replaced the untranslated transliteration 'joshen' with the Spanish common noun 'pectoral' for הַחֹשֶׁן (H2833, h02039019009), matching the rendering already used for this noun elsewhere in Éxodo (e.g. 28:26, 39:16, 39:17).
readerNote: hold: clause role — «los» in «los pusieron» names the two rings, carried over as object from the prior clause, as what was placed on the two ends of the pectoral; the verb has no object marker in the Hebrew here, so this is left unchanged.
